definition: to be good enough to justify the effort
description: On a rocky mountain summit at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds, a young woman in a coral sports top and black leggings sits barefoot on the rock and raises both fists in triumph, while a young man in a navy vest and beige shorts lies back on the rock laughing with his arms spread. She lowers her arms, smiles at him and then lies back on the rock too. Hiking boots, socks, a water bottle, trekking poles and backpacks lie in front, and a wild goat stands on the rocks to the right.

taps.phrase: to stand on a rocky ledge
